title: Best Muay Thai Gym Software: Prices & Fight Team Tools (2026)
description: Muay Thai gym software compared: Zen Planner, Spark, Dojo Champ, Kicksite, Martialytics and Gymdesk on armband ranks, fight team tracking and published prices.
body:
A Muay Thai gym usually mixes recreational members with a fight team, runs technique classes, pad rounds and sparring on one schedule, and often ranks students with armbands rather than belts. This page compares six tools on what each vendor says about Muay Thai and on its published prices, checked November 6, 2026. Only Zen Planner and Spark Membership have a page written specifically for Muay Thai gyms, and Dojo Champ names Muay Thai on its MMA page; for the other three we found no Muay Thai mention, so treat them as general martial arts tools.

{{table:zen-planner,spark-membership,dojo-champ,kicksite,martialytics,gymdesk}}

What each vendor says about Muay Thai

  • Zen Planner has a Muay Thai gym management page. It says built-in rank tracking handles armband ranks, prajioud levels and skill milestones, lets you set up beginner, advanced, sparring and fight team classes with their own schedules and pricing, and includes automated billing, lead follow-ups through Zen Planner Engage, and attendance via check-in from the app. Its MMA page also names Muay Thai as a program you can give its own schedule, membership and pricing tier.
  • Spark Membership's Muay Thai gym software page says it runs technique classes, pad rounds, sparring and open mat on one shared calendar, keeps fight team attendance, contact info and records in the same CRM as regular members, and offers automatic billing with failed-payment recovery, two-way SMS for new leads, and a member app for self check-in. The page says Spark was built by two 7th Dan black belts who ran martial arts schools.
  • Dojo Champ's MMA gym page lists Muay Thai and boxing among the disciplines you can manage with separate tracking, plus fighter development tracking (competition readiness, training camp attendance) and flexible memberships. Its pricing page shows one flat $199/mo plan with unlimited students and a 30-day trial that requires a card.
  • Kicksite, Martialytics and Gymdesk don't mention Muay Thai on the pages we checked. Kicksite's navigation lists Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Karate, Krav Maga, MMA, Taekwondo and Wrestling business types. Martialytics lists MMA gyms, karate dojos, BJJ gyms, taekwondo dojangs and kung fu schools. Gymdesk describes per-program rank progression and multi-program attendance for martial arts and MMA. A Muay Thai gym can still set up programs and ranks in them, but ask for a demo with your armband system before committing.

Small gym (under 50 members)

Kicksite has the lowest published price at $49/mo for 0-25 students ($99 for 26-50). Martialytics is $69/mo for up to 50 students and Gymdesk is $75/mo for up to 50 active members with Gymdesk Payments ($100/mo with your own processor). If armband tracking is the deciding feature, Zen Planner is the one with a Muay Thai rank-tracking claim, starting from $99/mo. {{aff:zenplanner|Visit Zen Planner}}

Gyms with a fight team

Spark Membership is the only vendor here that says on its Muay Thai page that fight team attendance and records live in the same CRM as regular members. Dojo Champ lists fighter development and training camp attendance tracking on its MMA page. Zen Planner lists fight team classes with their own schedules and pricing. {{aff:sparkmembership|Visit Spark Membership}} · {{aff:dojochamp|Visit Dojo Champ}}

Growing gym (100-200 members)

Martialytics is $129/mo for 101-200 students with every feature, unlimited users and locations. Kicksite is $199/mo for 101+. Gymdesk is $150/mo (101-150) or $200/mo (151-250) with Gymdesk Payments. Dojo Champ and Spark each list a single $199/mo price. Zen Planner's price depends on active members and the exact figure isn't published. {{aff:martialytics|Visit Martialytics}}

faq: Is there software made specifically for Muay Thai gyms?

Not that we found. Zen Planner and Spark Membership each have a page written for Muay Thai gyms, and Dojo Champ names Muay Thai on its MMA page, but all of them are general martial arts platforms. We found no Muay Thai mention on the pages we checked for Kicksite, Martialytics or Gymdesk.
Can the software track armband ranks?

Zen Planner's Muay Thai page says its rank tracking handles armband ranks, prajioud levels and skill milestones. We didn't find an armband claim on the other vendors' pages, so ask for a demo that sets up your own rank system.
Which tools can track a fight team?

Spark Membership says its CRM keeps fight team attendance, contact info and records alongside regular members. Dojo Champ's MMA page lists fighter development and training camp attendance tracking, and Zen Planner's Muay Thai page lists fight team classes with their own schedules and pricing.
What is the cheapest option for a small Muay Thai gym?

Of the published prices we checked on November 6, 2026, Kicksite starts at $49/mo for 0-25 students, Martialytics at $69/mo for up to 50 students, and Gymdesk at $75/mo for up to 50 active members with Gymdesk Payments ($100/mo with your own processor). Zen Planner starts from $99/mo and Spark and Dojo Champ list $199/mo. Kicksite, Martialytics and Gymdesk don't mention Muay Thai on the pages we checked.
Do these tools have free trials?

Martialytics and Gymdesk offer 30 days with no credit card, Kicksite says your first 30 days are free, Dojo Champ offers 30 days with a card required (first charge on day 31 if not cancelled), and Spark Membership offers 8 weeks. We couldn't find a published free trial for Zen Planner.
